name: Bureau of Labor Statistics API
tagline: Official U.S. labor statistics: employment, inflation, wages, and economic indicators via public API
description: The BLS Public Data API provides programmatic access to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics time series data, including employment, unemployment, CPI inflation, wages, and productivity. Developers can request single or multiple series, with optional registration for higher daily limits. Responses are JSON (v2) or JSON/XML (v1).

auth.details: Optional registration key for higher limits; pass as registrationkey query param or in POST body. Unregistered access allowed with lower daily caps.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free; unregistered 25 queries/day (25 series/query); registered 500 queries/day (50 series/query). No paid plans.

rate_limits: Unregistered: 25 queries/day, 25 series/query; registered: 500 queries/day, 50 series/query. Also 50 requests per 10 seconds for both registered and unregistered.
use_cases: fetch CPI inflation time series for a date range
pull unemployment rate series by geography
get employment and wage indicators for economic dashboards
batch-retrieve multiple BLS series IDs in one request
compare labor market metrics year-over-year for analysis
